edits.old: Then every alert links one runbook entry with the check, the owner role and the recovery step, and the capacity per environment is stated as a values entry
edits.new:
Then every alert links one runbook entry with the check, the owner role and the recovery step, and the capacity per environment is stated as a values entry

  Scenario: AC9 The deployment meets the business rules BR1 to BR9 in section 8 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the released rwb-source-data deployment in SIT
    When each rule in section 8 is checked against the release
    Then the release uses only the rwb_source_data login, runs its Flyway sequence in that schema and writes no other schema
    Then every topic has a retry topic and a .dlt topic, and every Schedule and every alert follows its rule
    Then no environment value is hard-coded and no personal data appears in a log, a series, an alert payload or the runbook

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is not acknowledged (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call that is stubbed to fail or to leave without an answer
    When the listener or the worker handles the event that carries the call
    Then the event is not acknowledged and is retried on the retry topic
    Then after the retries the event is moved to the .dlt topic and the failure is counted
    Then no freshness stamp is written from that event

  Scenario: AC11 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a batch row whose status change is not allowed by the model
    When the listener reads the change
    Then the change is refused and counted and no workflow run starts for it
    Then no freshness stamp is written from the refused change
